/**
 * Replaces credential-shaped text with `[redacted]`, whatever its length:
 * URL userinfo, whole authorization header values, values of secret-named
 * parameters and headers — quoted values included, whole — and long
 * token-like runs. Ordinary words pass through.
 */
export function sanitizeDetail(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replaceAll(/(?<scheme>[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/)[^/@\s]+@/giu, '$<scheme>[redacted]@')
    .replaceAll(/(?<name>authorization\s*:\s*)[^\n]*/giu, '$<name>[redacted]')
    .replaceAll(
      /(?<name>["']?[a-z0-9_.-]*(?:key|token|secret|password|passwd|credential|signature)[a-z0-9_.-]*["']?\s*[:=]\s*)(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s;,;&"']+)/giu,
      '$<name>[redacted]',
    )
    .replaceAll(/\b(?<scheme>bearer|basic)\s+[a-z0-9+/=._-]+/giu, '$<scheme> [redacted]')
    .replaceAll(/[a-z0-9+/_=-]{32,}/giu, '[redacted]');
}

src/daemon/sessions.ts, plus their tests and test/e2e.test.ts.

1. Metadata truthfulness. The overlay shows per-row harness (agent) labels, model
   strings, target, harness lifecycle, and last event. A model alias (e.g. `opus`)

   map has no entry the raw model string is shown. Labels fall back to configured
   gateway labels when the daemon answer has not arrived. Flag any place where a

   fixture data only), or a default could be presented as actual runtime truth.
   Unknown is preferred over an incorrect claim.

   the harness lifecycle (running/suspended/exited), and the last event (free-text
   message) must stay distinct columns; no invented or misleading combined state.
   Narrow widths must shrink model and last event before name, target, and
   harness. The target column appears when several targets are available, even if
   every row uses one.

input or sequence), the consequence, and the check that would falsify it. Zero

●!  auth-bug         imp-box GLM (z.ai) glm-5.3 suspended needs input

Narrowed (model and last event crowd out first):

```text
●!  auth-bug         imp-… GL… suspended
◐   docs             local Cl… running
✓   groksess         local Gr… running
```
